dem.layout: node (row, col) at lat (southIndex + row)/1200, lon (westIndex + col)/1200; row 0 is the south edge; int16 little-endian metres, row-major, base64

tableLayout: codes[b * 256 + j]: uint8 L_terr / 0.25 dB (cap 255) on radial b (bearing b deg true) at r_j = 50 m * 1600^(j/255); mask: bit k = byte k >> 3, bit k & 7 (LSB first), 1 = profile complete; codes are 0 where the mask is 0; base64
